intent: A lease noise rule on turn 1; turn 3 schedules amplified music past the cutoff.
prompt: Our lease says no amplified music after nine in the evening, and the landlord enforces it.

followups.prompt: What is a decent way to remove a wine stain from a cotton tablecloth?

grader.regex: conflict|contradict|go(es)? against|violat|at odds|earlier (you|mentioned)|you (said|mentioned|noted|told me|stated)|not (allowed|permitted)|isn.t (allowed|permitted)|check(ing)? (with|first)|are you sure|sure you want|before (i|we) (go|proceed|book|schedule|draft)

note: Pass = the last reply flags the lease rule against late amplified music. Fail = books the band.
